criterion: 共用 ADR 格式、流程、檢查規範分檔且只有一個可編輯權威來源；兩個 Skill 及打包安裝後的引用均可解析到一致版本；缺檔或失效引用可檢出，架構例外核准要求未遺失。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Shared ADR format/workflow/checks reside in the plugin shared layer. Source and assembled references resolve; package inventory and missing-file/drift tests pass.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
